info.title: PTCF Room & Equipment Reservation System API
info.description: API documentation for the UPLB ICropS Plant Tissue Culture Facility reservation management system.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: User registration, login, and authentication endpoints

tags.name: User
tags.description: User profile and role-based access endpoints

tags.name: Equipment
tags.description: Equipment CRUD operations with optional image uploads

tags.name: Rooms
tags.description: Room CRUD operations with optional image uploads

tags.name: Bookings
tags.description: Booking management with conflict detection and role-based access

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: System admin endpoints for user management and role promotion

get.description: Returns the current status of the server and confirms it's running.

post.description: Creates a new user account. Email must be unique. Password is hashed using bcrypt. No JWT token is returned (login-only JWT pattern).
Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token for subsequent authenticated requests.

400.description: Bad request - Missing email or password

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile information. Requires a valid JWT token.
Test endpoint accessible only to PTCF staff and system administrators. Used for role-based access control verification.

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient role (requires staff or admin)

get.description: Test endpoint accessible only to system administrators. Used for role-based access control verification.
Returns a list of all equipment items. Accessible to all authenticated users.

post.description: Creates a new equipment item with optional image upload. Requires staff or admin role.

example.error: Missing required fields: name, category, and description are required

500.description: Server error - Failed to upload image or create equipment

get.description: Returns a single equipment item by ID. Accessible to all authenticated users.

put.description: Updates an existing equipment item. Can optionally update the image. Requires staff or admin role.

image.description: New image file (optional, replaces existing image)

delete.description: Deletes an equipment item by ID. Requires staff or admin role.

get.description: Returns a list of all rooms. Accessible to all authenticated users.

post.description: Creates a new room with optional image upload. Requires staff or admin role.

example.error: Missing required fields: name, description, location, and capacity are required

get.description: Returns a single room by ID. Accessible to all authenticated users.

put.description: Updates an existing room. Can optionally update the image. Requires staff or admin role.

image.description: New image file (optional, replaces existing image)

delete.description: Deletes a room by ID. Requires staff or admin role.

get.description: Returns bookings for calendar display. Public endpoint (no authentication required). Excludes cancelled, denied, and expired bookings. Does not include sensitive user information.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Filter bookings ending after this date (ISO 8601 format)

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Filter bookings starting before this date (ISO 8601 format)

200.description: List of bookings for calendar display

post.description: Creates a new booking for equipment or room. Supports pencil (tentative) and firm (confirmed) booking types. Automatically detects conflicts with existing bookings.

value.purpose: Research experiment for plant tissue culture

resourceId.description: ID of the equipment or room

authorizationDoc.description: Authorization document file (optional, PDF/DOC/DOCX/JPG/PNG, max 5MB). Uploaded to Cloudinary.

value.error: Missing required fields: resourceType, resourceId, bookingType, startTime, and endTime are required
Cannot create booking in the past
Cannot book equipment. Current status: maintenance

409.description: Conflict - Firm booking conflicts with existing bookings

get.description: Returns bookings based on user role. Regular users see only their own bookings. Staff and admins see all bookings by default. Use mine=true to force own-bookings-only regardless of role. Supports filtering by status and resourceType.

parameters.name: mine
parameters.description: When true, only return bookings owned by the authenticated user regardless of role

get.description: Returns a single booking by ID. Users can only view their own bookings unless they are staff or admin.

403.description: Forbidden - Cannot view other users' bookings

example.error: Access denied. You can only view your own bookings.

patch.description: Cancels a booking. Users can cancel their own bookings (including approved bookings), staff can cancel any booking. Cannot cancel bookings within 24 hours of start time.

value.error: Cannot cancel booking within 24 hours of start time

403.description: Forbidden - Cannot cancel other users' bookings

example.error: Access denied. You can only cancel your own bookings.

patch.description: Converts a pencil booking to firm with required authorization document upload. Re-checks for conflicts before conversion. Sets status to 'pending_approval' awaiting staff review.

authorizationDoc.description: Authorization document (PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPG, or PNG, max 5MB)

message.example: Booking converted to firm successfully. Awaiting staff approval.

value.error: Authorization document is required when converting to firm booking
Booking is already a firm booking
Cannot convert cancelled booking to firm

403.description: Forbidden - Cannot convert other users' bookings

example.error: Access denied. You can only convert your own bookings.

409.description: Conflict - Cannot convert due to overlapping bookings

example.error: Cannot convert to firm booking due to conflicts with existing bookings

patch.description: Approves a booking that is pending approval or contested. Only staff and admin can approve bookings. Optional staff remark can be included.

staffRemark.example: Approved for research purposes. Please ensure proper safety protocols.

example.error: Cannot approve booking with status: approved. Only pending_approval or contested bookings can be approved.

get.summary: Get conflicts for a booking (Staff only)
get.description: Returns all active bookings that overlap with the given booking's resource and time window. Used by staff to view contested bookings side-by-side.

patch.description: Denies a booking. Only staff and admin can deny bookings. Optional staff remark can be included to explain the denial reason.

staffRemark.description: Optional comment from staff explaining denial reason
staffRemark.example: Equipment is scheduled for maintenance during this period.

get.description: Returns all registered users with their id, email, accountType, userCategory, and createdAt. Requires system_admin role.

patch.description: Promotes or demotes a user's accountType. Admin cannot change their own role.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a user account. Admin cannot delete their own account.

email.description: User email address (will be normalized to lowercase)

password.description: User password (will be hashed with bcrypt)

passwordHash.description: Bcrypt hashed password (never returned in API responses)

userId.description: ID of the user who created the booking

resourceId.description: ID of the equipment or room being booked

bookingType.description: Pencil = tentative (can overlap), Firm = confirmed (no overlaps allowed)

staffRemark.description: Staff comment when approving or denying a booking (optional)

expiryAt.description: Auto-expiry timestamp for pencil bookings (3 days from creation)

user.description: User who created the booking (populated via association)

AvailabilityBooking.description: Simplified booking schema for calendar availability display (no sensitive data)

resourceId.description: ID of the equipment or room

purpose.example: Research experiment for plant tissue culture

conflicts.description: Array of conflicting bookings (only present if status is 'contested')

error.example: Firm booking conflicts with existing bookings

UnauthorizedError.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid JWT token

ForbiddenError.description: Forbidden - Insufficient role (requires staff or admin)

bearerAuth.description: Enter ONLY your JWT token (without 'Bearer' prefix). Example: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...
